ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot via bcdedit for EDR sabotage
ucs.description: Detects the distinctive Qilin/Agenda tradecraft of using `bcdedit /set {default} safeboot network|minimal` to force the host into Safe Mode where most EDR sensors (including Defender real-time protection) do not load, immediately before file encryption. This boot-state manipulation is a hallmark of Agenda's Rust/Go ransomware binaries.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_id) as pids from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*network*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*minimal*") by Processes.dest Processes.user host
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$")
| eval mitre_technique="T1562.009", threat_actor="Qilin/Agenda"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("network", "minimal")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                 // exclude SYSTEM/machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
| where CommandLine has "safeboot"
| where CommandLine has_any ("network", "minimal")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, NewProcessId
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Safe-Mode Boot Configuration via bcdedit
id: 7c2e0a6e-3c2b-4f6a-9b1a-0aa0c2b94e7c
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit.exe being used to set the default boot entry into Safe Mode (network or minimal). Characteristic of Qilin/Agenda ransomware which reboots victims into Safe Mode to neutralise EDR before encryption.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/009/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'safeboot'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'network'
      - 'minimal'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised admin troubleshooting (rare and should be ticketed)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"safeboot network"* OR *"safeboot minimal"* OR *"SAFEBOOT NETWORK"* OR *"SAFEBOOT MINIMAL"* OR *"SafeBoot Network"* OR *"SafeBoot Minimal"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/safeboot\s+(network|minimal)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]))
ucs.rationale: Safe Mode boot manipulation is a specific Qilin/Agenda (Russian RaaS, criminal motivation) signature observed since 2024 — their Rust/Go encryptor explicitly invokes bcdedit safeboot before forced reboot to run encryption with EDR offline. While Snatch/REvil also touched safe mode, Qilin's documented playbook pairs this with their bespoke service-killing routine. Bcdedit safeboot is near-zero outs

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda pre-encryption sabotage chain: mass service kill + shadow copy & recovery wipe
ucs.description: Correlates two phases of Qilin's pre-encryption preparation observed across published incident reports: (a) bulk termination of backup/AV/DB services via net/sc/taskkill against Agenda's embedded process list (Veeam, MSSQL, Exchange, AV vendors, memtas, mepocs), and (b) shadow-copy/recovery destruction via vssadmin, wmic, wbadmin and bcdedit recoveryenabled=No within a tight window. The conjunction is highly specific to Qilin/Agenda's hard-coded sabotage routine.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as binaries from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=15m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval kill_hit=if(match(mvjoin(cmds,"|"),"(?i)(veeam|backup|mssql\b|sqlserver|sqlwriter|sophos|sentinel|crowdstrike|mcafee|defender|msexchange|exchange|acronis|memtas|mepocs|svc\$)"),1,0)
| eval wipe_hit=if(match(mvjoin(cmds,"|"),"(?i)(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|delete\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)"),1,0)
| eval kill_actions=mvcount(mvfilter(match(cmds,"(?i)(stop|/IM|/F)")))
| where kill_hit=1 AND wipe_hit=1 AND kill_actions>=5
| where NOT match(user,"(?i).*\$$")
| eval threat_actor="Qilin/Agenda", mitre_technique="T1489+T1490"
| sort -_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 15m;
let KillTargets = dynamic(["veeam","backup","mssql","sqlserver","sqlwriter","sophos","sentinel","crowdstrike","mcafee","defender","msexchange","exchange","acronis","memtas","mepocs"]);
let Killers = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop","/IM","/F","delete")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (KillTargets)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize KillCount = count(),
                KillTargetsSeen = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 30),
                FirstKill = min(Timestamp)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket=bin(Timestamp, WindowMin);
let Wipers = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ((ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no") or (ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" and ProcessCommandLine has "ignoreallfailures")))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | summarize WipeBinaries = make_set(FileName),
                WipeCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
                FirstWipe = min(Timestamp)
                by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, Bucket=bin(Timestamp, WindowMin);
Killers
| join kind=inner Wipers on DeviceId, AccountName, Bucket
| where KillCount >= 5                              // empirical: Agenda kills 10-40, alert at >=5
| project Bucket, DeviceName, AccountName,
          KillCount, KillTargetsSeen,
          WipeBinaries, WipeCmds,
          FirstKill, FirstWipe,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstWipe, FirstKill)
| order by Bucket desc

ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (
  (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* @CommandLine:*delete*)
  OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"*)
  OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*))
  OR (@Image:(*\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.exe OR *\\taskkill.exe OR *\\TaskKill.exe) @CommandLine:(*veeam* OR *Veeam* OR *VEEAM* OR *mssql* OR *MSSQL* OR *memtas* OR *MEMTAS* OR *mepocs* OR *MEPOCS* OR *msexchange* OR *MSExchange*))
) -@User:*$
